statement: The literal rational drilling of the two candidate involution fixed labels requires deleting exactly sixteen additional points from the rank-eleven source. Each added meridian fills to identity in the original source but maps to a primitive two-point twist generating a full closed Zhat, so this particular completed drilling map cannot factor through the original source. The actual six-point retained family has a fully embedded rank-three source and two explicitly distinguished degree-two four-point covering maps, one by ordinary forgetting and one by the branched involution quotient.
depends_on: F12 actual based eight-point configuration and involution; F15 actual free marked orbits and fixed points at the basepoint; the explicit rational collision identities, primitive winding characters, and finite-index covering topology proved here
manuscript_passages: Section 30, folios 194-196, scans 383-387; Section 31, folios 198-199 verso, scans 391-394; Part F(b), the exact residual centralizer and its source-membership problem.
depends_on_doubtful_reading: None. The three punctured source curves have their literal filling maps, the two newly marked points are ordered rational functions, the sixteen collision points and based meridians are specified, and the ordinary four-point forgetting map is kept separate from the branched four-point quotient map by its exact parameter.
computational_checks: code/part_a/common_reflection_drilling_f17.py and adjacent JSON/stdout execute 445 exact checks over Q(zeta_5): collision factorizations and separations, simple zeros and nonvanishing denominators, both six-point quotient and sheet-label formulas, and primitive winding detection in finite primary reductions.
notes: The sources Y dagger, Y and Y0 have ranks 27, 11 and 3. The extra squared parameters are A_u=u(2 zeta-u) and B_u=zeta u^2/(2u-zeta), with B_u=1/conjugate(A_u). The ten-point map forgets the new labels to the original source map; forgetting the four v_u with u not zeta factors through Y0. The ordinary four-point parameter is a^2 and the involution-quotient parameter is s^2/zeta^2. Full topology is proved for the rank-three six-point image by its actual degree-two ordinary-forgetting composite. No injectivity of the whole ten-point source map, no failure of every other possible homomorphic lift, and no solution of the original residual equalizer are asserted.
